import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

df = pd.read_excel('inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx', sheet_name='MAGeCK P-values')

# Extract chronic round 1 replicates
s1 = df['Chronic Round1 S1']
s2 = df['Chronic Round1 S2']

print('S1 stats: min={}, max={}, mean={}, non-null={}'.format(s1.min(), s1.max(), s1.mean(), s1.notna().sum()))
print('S2 stats: min={}, max={}, mean={}, non-null={}'.format(s2.min(), s2.max(), s2.mean(), s2.notna().sum()))

# Check for missing values
print('NaN in S1:', s1.isna().sum())
print('NaN in S2:', s2.isna().sum())

# Compute Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(s1, s2)
print('Spearman rho:', rho)
print('Spearman p-value:', pval)
"
